change: Shard of the Keel 4% -> 15% per full Wreck clear
rationale: Not the wall: with Crown at its ceiling the Keel barely moves the key (rate_search.csv), but 15% gives 2.5 a dedicated weekend so duplicates feed trade, the pity (RUL-104 item 2).

change: Shard of the Crown 40% -> 100% per Crownhold clear
rationale: Crownhold is Lantern-gated: about 0.067 clears per play hour for every player type, so even 100% gives only 0.68 Crown shards a dedicated weekend. The Crown is the wall at any legal rate; the pacing targets are out of reach without more Crownhold runs (see README).

change: Shard of the Tide 25% -> 75% (Sealed Reliquary, The Fall, both Rotted runs)
rationale: Epic and tainted runs are scarce (steeping eats the Epic charts): 0.13 clears an hour. 75% puts the Tide just above the Crown (0.98 a dedicated weekend), so the Tide is not a second wall.

change: Shard of the Ledger 15% -> 35% per Haul clear
rationale: 1.27 a dedicated weekend; the hardcore Reserve-chasing route clears fewer Hauls (0.17 an hour at 100% against 0.36), and 35% keeps its p50 under one weekend.
